thresholds.rule: a change passes when it closes at least half of the gap to CM1 in both the mixed depth and the 0.3-6.2 km vapour drop

evidence: Single-column calculations on PlaSim's fifteen levels driven by the CM1 boxes' own forcing, as in the first column test (one realization each of the settled sea box and the 0 E land box on a 6 km grid). In setup cm1 CM1's microphysics and resolved transport are prescribed from its domain diagnostics, each output one time step's domain mean, interpolated linearly between the 3-hourly outputs; the resolved transport carries the box's resolved boundary-layer eddies, so beneath it PlaSim's mixing stands for CM1's boundary-layer scheme and the nonlocal scheme counts part of the eddies twice below its top. CM1's lid exchange from its own flux diagnostics (box_lid). No GCM or CM1 run and no Fortran change.
reading_rule: cases: each column's compared quarter, by convection setup (massflux: the testbed as it stood; cm1: CM1's microphysics and resolved transport in place of the scheme; massflux_shallow_night: the scheme limited to shallow convection while the Sun is down, shallow_only) and boundary layer (as in the first test). measures as in the first test. lid: the heat and vapour (W/m2, upward) the column carries through its interface nearest 6.7 km (7.1 km) by diffusion and dry adjustment (mixing), with cm1_transport the part CM1's prescribed transport carries there and total their sum; cm1.lid: CM1's parts (box_lid) averaged over its levels at 6.45 and 6.99 km over the same quarter: resolved, diffusion (the advection's implicit diffusion), subgrid (its boundary-layer scheme) and total; khv its scheme's diffusivity. gap_closed_within: 1 - |x - CM1| / |earth_local - CM1| with the same setup's earth_local; gap_closed_from_testbed: the same against the testbed's earth_local (massflux). setup_closes_half_of_testbed_gap: the setup's earth_local closes at least half of the testbed's gap in depth and drop; nonlocal_closes_half_within: lunar_nonlocal closes at least half of its setup's earth_local gap in both. water_mm_day and heat_w_m2: the budget's terms over the quarter, with prescribed the cm1 tendencies' column sums and floor the water the floor on vapour adds; residuals: what each budget leaves.
